# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 21 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam's Soul Departs; Angels Mourn

---

**1** When Adam had heard all these things from his son Seth, he was greatly comforted and said: 'Blessed is the Lord God, who does not forsake those who seek him.'

**2** Adam said: 'My sons, I know my hour has come and I am going to die. Do not grieve for me, but gather around me and tend to my body when I die.'

**3** Adam stretched out his hands and feet and gave up his spirit to God.

**4** The sun and moon went dark, and the stars ceased to shine for seven days.

**5** The angels of God came and mourned over Adam, and the firmament trembled and all the heavens were in darkness.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
